risk: PostgreSQL torna-se gargalo de estado, outbox, audit e scheduler
trigger: lock wait, pool saturation ou p95 crescente
contingency: admission control; query/lock profiling; scale-up or new ADR

risk: Filesystem esgota IOPS ou espaço temporário durante raster/mosaico
trigger: disk queue, temp usage or publication latency
contingency: backpressure, quotas, out-of-core, capacity expansion

risk: RabbitMQ acumula backlog ou atinge watermark de disco
trigger: oldest message age and broker alarms
contingency: close admission, drain by class, quarantine

risk: Deadlock, lease vencido ou owner antigo publica resultado
contingency: bounded retry, stale-owner rejection, incident review

risk: Estágio GDAL/OpenCV longo não alcança safe point de cancelamento
contingency: chunk stage, recycle worker, quarantine attempt

risk: Single instance é ponto único de falha
contingency: restore on replacement host; communicate no-HA SLO

risk: proj-data, EPSG grids ou ABI nativa muda resultado científico
contingency: pin data/image, regression corpus, rollback digest

risk: Provider externo muda API, licença ou disponibilidade
contingency: disable provider, use local/manual reference, update adapter

risk: OIDC indisponível ou linking incorreto bloqueia usuários
contingency: local account recovery and explicit relinking ceremony

risk: Driver, runtime ou ModelPack incompatível causa falha/divergência
contingency: disable GPU/backend, CPU/classic fallback

risk: Filesystem não oferece rename/fsync/locking esperados
contingency: fail installation; move to supported filesystem

risk: Browser/toolchain incompatível quebra workspace ou cliente
contingency: pin supported browsers/toolchain and rollback build

risk: PostGIS-specific model torna saída custosa
contingency: open exports and migration ADR

risk: Celery/RabbitMQ semantics vazam ao domínio
trigger: framework types or broker state becomes authoritative
contingency: TaskEnvelope/outbox boundary and conformance tests

risk: Carga excede teto de escala vertical da instância
trigger: SLO fails after supported hardware class
contingency: reject admission, larger class, or new scale-out ADR

risk: Claims de 40–300 imagens são publicados sem corpus e classe
contingency: block claim and release

risk: TCO ou custo unitário excede orçamento do Owner
trigger: monthly or unit cost variance over 20%
contingency: reforecast, retention/capacity tuning without relaxing quality

risk: Crescimento de originais, artifacts e backups torna storage dominante
contingency: retention classes, recomputation, capacity purchase

risk: GPU aumenta custo sem reduzir unidade econômica ou fila
contingency: remain CPU-only

risk: API, SSE ou fila perde responsividade sob processamento
contingency: admission control, isolation and capacity correction

risk: Aging/fairness falha e classe interativa sofre starvation
contingency: reserve capacity, breaker, policy rollback

risk: RPO/RTO não é atingido ou BackupSet diverge
contingency: block real data, repair backup, repeat drill

risk: Migration destrutiva elimina rollback
contingency: restore or forward-fix; block upgrade

risk: Mixed versions escrevem schemas incompatíveis
contingency: single writer, stop rollout, restore compatibility

risk: Evento administrativo ou científico não entra no audit ledger
contingency: block release, reconstruct evidence, incident

risk: Cardinalidade ou payload sensível torna telemetry cara/insegura
trigger: label growth, cost or leak test failure
contingency: drop offending signals, redaction, bounded dimensions

risk: Conta, sessão, PAT ou autorização é comprometida
contingency: revoke, rotate, isolate, incident response

risk: Path traversal, symlink escape ou artifact serving indevido
contingency: fail closed, quarantine root, rotate credentials

risk: Imagem, pacote, ModelPack ou release não verificável é executado
contingency: block deployment and restore trusted digest

risk: Dados pessoais são coletados sem finalidade/base ou além do necessário
contingency: block collection, contain, delete when lawful, incident process

risk: Retenção, exclusão ou direitos divergem entre DB e artifacts
contingency: quarantine deletion, reconcile references, legal review

risk: Secret, raster, geolocation ou path absoluto entra em log/support bundle
contingency: revoke/rotate, purge bundle, incident response

risk: Falso positivo geométrico é aceito
contingency: rollback profile, quarantine outputs, revalidate

risk: AI publica ou influencia aceite sem SGV independente
contingency: disable backend, invalidate outputs, audit incident

risk: Provider, model or artifact perde attribution/licença válida
contingency: disable distribution/provider and remediate records

risk: Complexidade excede capacidade do mantenedor solo
trigger: unresolved alerts, slow recovery, WIP growth
contingency: reduce WIP, automate runbook, narrow supported envelope

risk: Alert fatigue ou runbook incompleto atrasa contenção
contingency: tune symptom alerts and exercise incident runbook

risk: Publicação ocorre sem gates de segurança, restore ou rollback
contingency: block/revoke release and restore previous digest

risk: Artifact, Prompt Bundle ou ModelPack incompatível é lido silenciosamente
contingency: fail closed, pin previous version, migrate explicitly

risk: Banco, filesystem e broker divergem após crash
contingency: reconcile from DB/manifests, quarantine partials, replay outbox
